from typing import Optional
import logging

LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)

class FlakesChecker:
    def __init__(self, options: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
        self.options = options
        self.doctest_filtering_enabled: Optional[bool] = None

    def start(self) -> None:
        LOG.info("Starting FlakesChecker")
        self.doctest_filtering_enabled = self.options.doctest_filtering

    def stop(self) -> None:
        LOG.info("Stopping FlakesChecker")

    @property
    def check_doctest_filtering(self) -> bool:
        return self.doctest_filtering_enabled or False

# Assuming argparse is imported elsewhere in your codebase
import argparse

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Flake8 Configuration Example")
    parser.add_argument("--doctest-filtering", action="store_true", help="Enable doctest filtering")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    checker = FlakesChecker(args)
    checker.start()
    print(f"Doctest Filtering Enabled: {checker.check_doctest_filtering}")
    checker.stop()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
